title: Editing an Isolation Profile for Private Access

blocks.text: After creating a Private Access (ZPA) isolation profile, you can edit the profile at any time.
To edit your Private Access isolation profile:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Zero Trust Browser > Browser Isolation Private Apps > Isolation Profile.
Click the Edit icon for the isolation profile that you want to edit.
In the Edit wizard, modify the information as necessary. To learn more, see Creating Isolation Profiles for Private Access.

blocks.text: You can use this isolation profile to create policies in Private Access to isolate specific web applications. To learn more, see Configuring Isolation Policies.
